name: Decide
why: A question or blocker, from where it arises to Claude's call or the owner's queue, then cleared for good
ideal: Claude makes every call its delegation allows and moves on; only questions and human steps reach the owner, and a false block is fixed once.

steps.name: Arise
steps.rule: A question or blocker surfaces once with its fix named; none costs more than it helps.

steps.name: Claude decides
steps.rule: Within its delegation Claude decides, records reason and reversal in the PR, and moves on.

steps.name: Owner's queue
steps.rule: Only questions and human steps reach the owner; any other prompt is a defect to remove.

steps.name: Clear
steps.rule: Few blocks are false alarms; each one on a safe command becomes a guard fix by PR.
